_meta.description: Heart event #3 for npc_kaydee: After Hours

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Late night. The tavern is empty. Kaydee is cleaning alone]

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Closing time was an hour ago, engineer.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: ...But I don't feel like kicking you out tonight.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: You ever notice how different this place is when it's empty?

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: During the day it's noise and laughter and performance.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: At night it's just... a room. With a woman wiping tables.

options.text: It's a good room. With a remarkable woman.
You don't have to perform for me.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: ...Careful, Jack. Flattery after midnight is dangerous.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: I might start believing you mean it.
